task: Add a Koala Story Capsule projection layer for resumable, auditable story handoff without weakening existing evidence and gate authority.
outcome: A user starts a fresh session, runs koala session_brief, and sees a Current Story Capsule block like: Story B-42c0, Phase DEV, Current checklist CHK-004, Last run implementer/pass, Next action rerun capsule smoke tests, Evidence refs valid. If they forge session-brief.md or delete an evidence ref, koala capsule_show or validate reports the missing reference instead of allowing DONE.
facts: Current configured storyDir in this repo is .koala/story/actives, so capsule paths must be resolved through StoryStore/loadConfig rather than hardcoded docs/story or Docs/story strings.
Koala already treats process-events.jsonl and evidence artifacts as authoritative process facts; session_brief is a read-only recovery view.
Verification Context Pack already solves verifier token scope; capsule should complement it as handoff/projection state, not replace it.
INIT reviewers passed B-42c0 with advisory-only issues and explicitly called out configured storyDir, OMX definition, and non-authoritative import semantics.
constraints: Capsule summaries must never become DONE gate evidence; they may only reference existing evidence and process-event facts.
All story metadata writes must use Koala CLI and StoryStore abstractions, not direct edits to story JSON.
New CLI commands must be registered in command policy, process fact levels, process fact registry, and ownership contracts as appropriate.
Tests must prove missing evidenceRefs/processEventRefs are detected and forged session-brief.md cannot satisfy lifecycle gates.
OMX import is optional and non-authoritative; deleting .omx must not affect Koala behavior.
unknowns: Exact CLI option surface for capsule_update, capsule_handoff, capsule_run_add, and capsule_import_omx should be finalized during implementation against existing CLI schema style.
Whether missing capsule refs should be hard-fail in all commands or warn in read-only display and hard-fail in validation needs explicit handler design.
How much run transcript text to persist by default should remain compact to avoid privacy and repository-size issues.
